filters.description:
# Filter Structure

## 1. Logical Group (`and` / `or`)

```json
{
  "and": [
    { "column_name": "Status", "operator": "equal", "value": { "single_select": "Done" } },
    { "column_name": "Priority", "operator": "greater_than", "value": { "number": 3 } }
  ]
}
```

## 2. Nested Group (max 2 levels)

```json
{
  "and": [
    { "column_name": "Status", "operator": "equal", "value": { "single_select": "Done" } },
    {
      "or": [
        { "column_name": "Priority", "operator": "equal", "value": { "number": 1 } },
        { "column_name": "Priority", "operator": "equal", "value": { "number": 2 } }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

---

# Condition Fields


| Key        | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `column_name` | `string` | **Yes**  | The column name.                                                                                                                              |
| `operator` | `string` | **Yes**  | The filter operator (see below).                                                                                                              |
| `value`    | `object` | No       | The filter value. **Not required** when `operator` is `is_empty` or `is_not_empty`. Only **one key** should be set, matching the column type. |


---

# Filter Operators


| Operator             | Description                       |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `equal`              | Equal to                          |
| `not_equal`          | Not equal to                      |
| `greater_than`       | Greater than                      |
| `greater_than_equal` | Greater than or equal to          |
| `less_than`          | Less than                         |
| `less_than_equal`    | Less than or equal to             |
| `contains`           | Contains                          |
| `not_contains`       | Does not contain                  |
| `is_empty`           | Is empty (no `value` needed)      |
| `is_not_empty`       | Is not empty (no `value` needed)  |
| `starts_with`        | Starts with                       |
| `ends_with`          | Ends with                         |
| `contains_any_of`    | Contains any of the given values  |
| `contains_none_of`   | Contains none of the given values |
| `contains_all_of`    | Contains all of the given values  |


---

# Value Format by Column Type

## `text`

- **Format:** `{ "text": "Hello World!" }`
- **Operators:** `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `equal`, `not_equal`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`

## `number`

- **Format:** `{ "number": 12.14 }`
- **Operators:** `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `equal`, `not_equal`, `greater_than`, `greater_than_equal`, `less_than`, `less_than_equal`

## `percent`

- **Format:** `{ "percent": 200 }`
- **Note:** 200 means 200%, 1 means 1%.
- **Operators:** Same as `number`.

## `currency`

- **Format:** `{ "currency": 20000 }`
- **Operators:** Same as `number`.

## `single_select`

- **Format:** `{ "single_select": "Male" }`
- **Note:** Value is the **option name**.
- **Operators:** `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `equal`, `not_equal`, `contains_any_of`, `contains_none_of`

## `multiple_select`

- **Format:** `{ "multiple_select": ["Tag1", "Tag2"] }`
- **Note:** Value is an **array of option names**.
- **Operators:** `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `equal`, `contains_any_of`, `contains_all_of`, `contains_none_of`

## `date`

- **Format:** `{ "date": { "mode": "<mode>", "value": "<value>" } }`
- **`mode` is required.** The `value` field depends on the mode:


| Mode          | `value`                       | Example                                                  |
| ------------- | ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `exactly`     | ISO 8601 date string          | `{ "mode": "exactly", "value": "2025-07-03T05:52:37Z" }` |
| `past`        | Number of days ago (string)   | `{ "mode": "past", "value": "3" }`                       |
| `next`        | Number of days ahead (string) | `{ "mode": "next", "value": "7" }`                       |
| `today`       | Not required                  | `{ "mode": "today" }`                                    |
| `yesterday`   | Not required                  | `{ "mode": "yesterday" }`                                |
| `tomorrow`    | Not required                  | `{ "mode": "tomorrow" }`                                 |
| `currentweek` | Not required                  | `{ "mode": "currentweek" }`                              |


- **Operators:** `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `equal`, `not_equal`, `greater_than`, `greater_than_equal`, `less_than`, `less_than_equal`
- **Examples:**
  - Greater than current week: `"operator": "greater_than"`, `"value": { "date": { "mode": "currentweek" } }`
  - Less than a specific date: `"operator": "less_than"`, `"value": { "date": { "mode": "exactly", "value": "2025-07-03T05:52:37Z" } }`
  - Greater than 3 days ago: `"operator": "greater_than"`, `"value": { "date": { "mode": "past", "value": "3" } }`

## `people`

- **Format:** `{ "people": ["U3OwWitcRAShLhbG4ChXNQ"] }`
- **Note:** Value is an **array of user IDs**.
- **Operators:** `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `equal`, `not_equal`, `contains_any_of`, `contains_none_of`

## `checkbox`

- **Format:** `{ "checkbox": false }`
- **Operators:** `equal`

## `reaction`

- **Format:** `{ "reaction": 12 }`
- **Note:** Value is the **click count** (integer).
- **Operators:** `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `equal`, `not_equal`, `greater_than`, `greater_than_equal`, `less_than`, `less_than_equal`

## `url`

- **Format:** `{ "url": "https://www.google.com" }`
- **Operators:** `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `equal`, `not_equal`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`

## `attachment`

- **Format:** `{ "attachment": "document.txt" }`
- **Note:** Filtering is based on the **file name**.
- **Operators:** `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `equal`, `not_equal`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`

fields.description: If provided, only the values of the specified fields are returned. If not provided, the values of all fields are returned.

actions.name: insert_blocks_into_document
actions.description:
Insert blocks into a document. Insert new blocks at a specific position in a document. Accepts XML-formatted block content and supports positioning above, below, or inside a specific parent block. Use the Get file content endpoint with the query parameter `format=xml` first to fetch the document structure and block IDs.

**[Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs_content:write`

**[Granular Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs:write:content`

**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `LIGHT`

fileId.description: The document file ID.

positioning.description: Block positioning options. At most one of `above_block_id`, `below_block_id`, or `parent_block_id` should be specified. If none are specified, blocks are appended to the end of the document.

above_block_id.description: Block ID to insert above (mutually exclusive with below)

below_block_id.description: Block ID to insert below (mutually exclusive with above)

parent_block_id.description: Parent block ID. Inserts at the end of this parent's children.

blocks.description: XML string containing block content. See the [Zoom Docs XML Format Specification](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/zoom-docs/doc-format-specification) for supported block types and syntax.

actions.name: replace_range_of_blocks
actions.description:
Replace a range of blocks. Replace a contiguous range of sibling blocks with new blocks in a single atomic operation. All blocks between start and end (inclusive) are removed and replaced with the provided XML block content. Important: `start_block_id` and `end_block_id` must be direct children of the same parent block (siblings). If they are not siblings, the operation will fail. Use the Get file content endpoint to verify the document structure before calling this endpoint.

**[Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs_content:update`

**[Granular Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs:update:cont...

fileId.description: The document file ID.

blocks.description: XML string containing block content. See the [Zoom Docs XML Format Specification](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/zoom-docs/doc-format-specification) for supported block types and syntax.

start_block_id.description: Block ID of the first block in the range.

end_block_id.description: Block ID of the last block in the range.

actions.name: delete_specific_block
actions.description:
Delete a specific block. Deletes a block and all its content from the document.

**[Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs_content:delete`

**[Granular Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs:delete:content`

fileId.description: The doc file ID containing the block to delete.

blockId.description: The unique identifier of the block to delete.

actions.name: update_specific_block
actions.description:
Update a specific block. Updates the content of an existing block using XML-formatted content. Keeps the existing block type and replaces the content. To change the block type, use ReplaceBlockRange.

**[Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs_content:update`

**[Granular Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs:update:content`

**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `LIGHT`

fileId.description: The doc file ID.

blockId.description: The unique identifier of the block to update.

block.description: A single XML block string with the updated content. See the [Zoom Docs XML Format Specification](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/zoom-docs/doc-format-specification) for supported block types and syntax.

actions.description:
Create a file export. Creates a export for specified file.

The target format for export.

Get file export status. Use this API to query the status of a file export.

actions.name: get_file_content
actions.description:
Get file content. Retrieve the file name, full file content in the requested `format`, and a link to open the document. Supported formats: `markdown` or `xml`. Use `markdown` for reading or summarization; use `xml` to get an XML block tree with block IDs for block-level editing.

**[Granular Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs:read:export`

**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `CANVAS-EXPORT`

fileId.description: The unique identifier of the document file.

format.description: The format of the exported content. Supported formats: `markdown` returns the document content as Markdown text; `xml` returns an XML block tree where each block carries a block ID, used when you need block IDs for the block-level editing endpoints.

actions.name: create_new_file
actions.description:
Create a new file. Creates a new file for a user.

**[Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs:write`,`docs:write:admin`

**[Granular Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `docs:write:file`,`docs:write:file:admin`

**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `MEDIUM`

parent_id.description: The ID of the parent file. The newly created file will become a child of this parent. If this parameter is omitted, the file will be placed under "My Docs." Use "root" to represent the top-level folder of the current user. Folders can only be created under "My Docs," a shared folder, or another folder.

user_id.description: When invoked with the `admin` scope, this operation runs on behalf of the specified user. Permissions are validated against that user. This parameter is required with the `admin` scope and has no effect otherwise.

columns.description: The `columns` parameter is ignored when `file_type` is not `data_table`. When `file_type` is `data_table`, users can provide custom columns. If none are provided, three default columns—`text`, `people`, and `single_select`—along with a grid view will be created.

column_options.description:
The corresponding relationship between column type and column option is as follows:

`date`|`created_time`|`updated_time`: date_option
`number`: number_option
`currency`: currency_option
`percent`: percent_option
`url`: url_option
`attachment`: attachment_option
`reaction`: reaction_option
`single_select`|`multiple_select`: select_option
`people`: people_option

Other column types do not have a column option.

is_24_hour_format.description: If `true`, display in 24-hour format. If `false`, display in 12-hour format.

show_separator.description: If `true`, display thousand separators. If `false`, do not display thousand separators.

show_progress_bar.description: If `true`, display the progress bar. If `false`, do not display the progress bar.

is_multiple.description: If `true`, allow selection of multiple people. If `false`, only one person can be selected.

is_notify.description: If `true`, send a notification message after selecting someone. If `false`, do not send a notification message after selecting someone.

type.description: The icon display type. Currently only supports emoji.

allow_commenter_react.description: Whether a user with only commenter permission is allowed to click. If `true`, the user is allowed to click. If `false`, the user is not allowed to click.

format.description: The currency format.

actions.description:
Create file upload for docs import or attachments. Create a file upload for document import or attachments.

Notes:
- Base URL: https://fileapi.zoom.us/v2.

* When the poll's `type` value is the `2` (Advanced Poll) or `3` (Quiz) values, this value defaults to `false`.

answers.description:
The poll question's available answers. This field requires a **minimum** of two answers. 

* For `single` and `multiple` polls, you can only provide a maximum of 10 answers. 
* For `matching` polls, you can only provide a maximum of 16 answers. 
* For `rank_order` polls, you can only provide a maximum of seven answers.

case_sensitive.description:
Whether the correct answer is case sensitive. This field only applies to `fill_in_the_blank` polls. 
* `true` — The answer is case-sensitive. 
* `false` — The answer is not case-sensitive. 

This value defaults to `false`.

name.description:
The poll question, up to 255 characters. 

For `fill_in_the_blank` question, this field is the question text with placeholders for blanks (ex: `This is a <Blank 1> and is another <Blank 2>`. For each value that the user must fill in, ensure that there are the same number of `answers` values.

prompts.description: Information about the prompt questions. The question prompt's title. This field only applies to `matching` and `rank_order` polls. You **must** provide a minimum of two prompts, up to a maximum of 10 prompts.

prompt_right_answers.description:
The question prompt's correct answers. 
* For `matching` polls, you must provide a minimum of two correct answers, up to a maximum of 10 correct answers. 
* For `rank_order` polls, you can only provide one correct answer.

rating_max_label.description:
The high score label used for the `rating_max_value` field. 

This field only applies to the `rating_scale` poll.

rating_max_value.description:
The rating scale's maximum value, up to a maximum value of 10. 

This field only applies to the `rating_scale` poll.

rating_min_label.description:
The low score label used for the `rating_min_value` field. 

This field only applies to the `rating_scale` poll.

rating_min_value.description:
The rating scale's minimum value. This value cannot be less than zero. 

This field only applies to the `rating_scale` poll.

right_answers.description:
The poll question's correct answer(s). This field is **required** if the poll's `type` value is `3` (Quiz). 

 For `single` and `matching` polls, this field only accepts one answer.

show_as_dropdown.description:
Whether to display the radio selection as a drop-down box. 
* `true` — Show as a drop-down box. 
* `false` — Do not show as a drop-down box. 

This value defaults to `false`.

type.description:
The poll's question and answer type. 
* `single` — Single choice. 
* `multiple` — Multiple choice. 
* `matching` — Matching. 
* `rank_order` — Rank order. 
* `short_answer` — Short answer. 
* `long_answer` — Long answer. 
* `fill_in_the_blank` — Fill in the blank. 
* `rating_scale` — Rating scale.

title.description: The poll's title, up to 64 characters.

validation_level.description:
**Standard**: This is the default level. Ensures all required questions are answered and allowing unconfigured questions in the payload, though they won't be processed.
**Strict**: Ensures all required questions are answered and returns an http bad request error with error code 260503 if an unconfigured questions or answers are submitted.
**none**: Disables validation entirely. Questions are not checked for mandatory status, and any unconfigured question answers are ignored — the registration proceeds without validation of registration questions.

fast_join.description: Whether to support guest join i.e. Non-Zoom users (Fast join without upfront authentication). If true then the `registration_needed` flag should not be set to true as it is an invalid combination.

registration_needed.description:
Whether registrant needs to fill an online registration form.
 If **true** then the registration questions fields such as first_name, last_name, and address are not needed in the request body and are ignored if present. 
 Also, if **true** then event_registration_link is returned instead of event_join_link in the response.

 * `accelerated_auth` - Authentication through vanity URL.

security_code_at_join.description: Whether attendees must enter a security code when joining. This field is not required when `authentication_method` is `email_otp`.

actions.name: move_file
actions.description:
Move a file or folder into a target parent, optionally controlling its position among the target parent's children.

Moving a folder also moves all of its descendants. The operation runs synchronously; on success it returns no content.

A move is rejected when the target parent does not exist, when the target parent is the file being moved or a descendant of it (which would create a cycle), or when the caller lacks permission to remove the file from its current location or to add children to the target parent.

When invoked with an `admin` scope, this operation can move only individual files; moving folders is not supported and the request is rejected.

**[Scopes](https://developers.zoom....

fileId.description: The ID of the file or folder to move.

parent_id.description: The ID of the target parent that the file will be moved into. Use `root` to represent the top-level folder of the current user.

before_sibling_id.description: The ID of an existing child of the target parent. The moved file is inserted immediately before this sibling. If omitted, the moved file is appended after the target parent's last child.

user_id.description: When invoked with an `admin` scope, this operation runs on behalf of the specified user and permissions are validated against that user. This field is required when using an `admin` scope and is ignored otherwise.

actions.name: create_new_file_with_content
actions.description:
Create a new file from content. Creates a new file from plain-text content. The expected content format per file type: doc - Markdown; paper_doc - Markdown; spreadsheet - CSV.

The content is limited to 100 KB in size.

**[Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `hub_content:write`

**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `CANVAS-IMPORT`

**Not supported in Gov cluster**

file_type.description: The type of file to create.

parent_id.description: The ID of the parent file. The newly created file will become a child of this parent. If this parameter is omitted, the file will be placed under **My Files**. Use `root` to represent the top-level folder of the current user. Folders can only be created under **My Files**, a shared folder, or another folder.

* `sequential` — Devices ring one after another in the configured order.

actions.name: send_whats_app_message
actions.description:
Send WhatsApp message. Sends a WhatsApp message through a Zoom Phone WhatsApp Business Account (WABA). The sender phone number must be registered as a Meta WhatsApp Business phone number and linked to a WABA within the Zoom account.

**Supported Outbound Message Types**
* `text` — Free-text message. Only allowed within a 24-hour session window opened by an inbound message from the recipient.
* `template` — Highly Structured Message (HSM) template pre-approved by Meta. Can be sent at any time, including outside the 24-hour window.
* `image` / `document` — Rich media messages. Allowed only within the 24-hour session window. Media is delivered inline as base64-encoded content through `attach...

sender.description: The WhatsApp Business phone number to send from, in E.164 format. This number must be registered with Meta and linked to a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) in the Zoom account.

recipient.description: The recipient's phone number in E.164 format and registered on WhatsApp. WhatsApp supports individual (1:1) messaging only.

message_type.description:
The type of WhatsApp message to send. Determines which additional fields are required:
* `text` — Requires `message`. Only allowed within the 24-hour session window.
* `template` — Requires `template`. Can be sent at any time.
* `image` / `document` — Requires `attachments`. Only allowed within the 24-hour session window.

message.description: The text content of the message. Required when `message_type` is `text`. Maximum 4096 characters. Unicode and emoji are supported.

template.description: The template payload. Required when `message_type` is `template`. The template must be pre-approved by Meta before use.

name.description: The exact name of the Meta-approved message template.

language.description: The language code of the template, in BCP-47 format (e.g., `en_US`, `zh_CN`). Must match one of the languages in which the template was approved.

params.description: Named variable substitutions for the template body. Each key corresponds to a `{{variable_name}}` placeholder defined in the template. The value replaces the placeholder at send time.

attachments.description: The media asset(s) to send, encoded inline as base64. Required when `message_type` is `image` or `document`. Only allowed within the 24-hour session window. Currently only a single attachment is accepted per message; images (`JPG`/`JPEG`/`PNG`/`GIF`) are delivered as a WhatsApp image message, and `PDF` is delivered as a WhatsApp document message.

base64_encoding.description: The base64-encoded binary content of the media file.

type.description: The file type of the attachment. `JPG`, `JPEG`, `PNG`, and `GIF` are sent as a WhatsApp `image` message; `PDF` is sent as a WhatsApp `document` message.

session_id.description: The unique ID of an existing conversation session between the sender and recipient. If omitted, a new session is created or an existing active session is reused automatically.

search_text.description: The text to use for search. A minimum of 3 characters is needed to search.

videoId.description: The ID of the video. If the ID contains URL-reserved characters, double URL-encode the entire value before sending the request. For example, `F6/2jeddReCK+WUtDtxv3Q==_0003` becomes `F6%252F2jeddReCK%252BWUtDtxv3Q%253D%253D_0003`.

description.description: Detailed description or summary of the video content.

external_id.description: Used to link the migrated media ID from an external system.

notes.description: Additional information or notes about the video.

thumbnails.description: Thumbnail metadata updates. Each entry references an uploaded file by `file_id`.

file_id.description: The unique file reference ID from the file upload API.

transcripts.description: Transcript updates. Each item references an uploaded transcript file and can include a language code. The `language` field is currently supported only for videos with the source `RECORDING`. For all other video source types, `language` is ignored, and the provided transcript file overwrites the existing transcript, if present.

file_id.description: The unique file reference ID from the file upload API.

is_default.description: Whether this transcript file is the default caption file. The default transcript is displayed first by the player. When the first transcript file is uploaded, it automatically becomes the default regardless of whether this field is explicitly set.
